Browser-only / unported deps reduced and documented inline + here: react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> useNativeTranslation t(key,fallback?) = (fallback ?? key) preserving every key + English default (widget.chargingSessionDetail.title/energy/duration/peakPower/charger/powerKw/soc/unitKwh/empty + freshness.*); lucide Zap -> the ⚡ glyph (emerald title via colors.success, muted empty glyph); @/components/charts Recharts bundle -> native ChargeCurveChart View/AppText layers (no DOM/SVG; same #22c55e/#22d3ee colours + power/SoC domains + preserve-start-end labels); @/components/ui Badge -> native <Badge> chip (warning -> colors.warningSurface/warningBorder/warning; neutral -> surfaceRaised/border/textSecondary; size sm = px 6 / py 2 / 12px / rounded-full); @/components/feedback EmptyState -> native centered icon+muted message; useChargingSessions/useChargingSessionDetail/useChargeTelemetry/useVehicles -> already-ported native web-parity hooks (same keys/paths; request auto-prefixes /api/v1 so '/charging/{id}' and '/charging/{id}/telemetry' are kept verbatim by the hooks); fmtNumber -> inline en-US locale (min=max fraction digits); convertEnergyFromSI -> inlined verbatim (Wh / kWh); ./WidgetShell -> native shell reproducing the loading skeleton, error body, the 1500ms pulse-on-update glow and the inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph+relative time, tap-to-refresh, dot-only compact when title-less); ./shared WidgetChartSummary + ChartSummaryStat -> native equivalents (2-up stat grid + chart slot + EmptyState; {label,value,unit?}); ./types WidgetProps -> local WidgetSize {cols,rows} + WidgetProps interfaces.

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/span/h3 -> View/AppText; flex/grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 (@sm:flex) -> flexDirection row + flexWrap + columnGap/rowGap + per-cell flexBasis 45%/flexGrow 1; the compact 'h-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1' -> centered View (flexGrow 1, rowGap spacing.xs) with a text-2xl/font-bold emerald-300 value (#6ee7b7, fontSize 24/700) over a text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider muted eyebrow; CSS vars text-[var(--text-muted|primary)] -> colors.textMuted/textPrimary; the WidgetChartSummary value+unit span (ml-0.5 text-[10px] font-normal) -> a baseline-aligned row of a 14px/600 primary value + a 10px/400 muted unit; '—' em-dash kept as \u2014; chart literal colours #22c55e (Area)/#22d3ee (Line) preserved (dynamic chart colour exception). No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View/DimensionValue), the already-ported native useCharging/useVehicles hooks, the native AppText, and the theme tokens.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint . --quiet), and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest). This file is a standalone web-parity port and is not imported by any existing test; it is verified by typecheck + lint and does not regress the jest suite.
